Specification: This module specifies a very small state machine over a single variable f, where the initial state allows f to be any function in one of three explicitly given function sets. The state never changes after initialization, because the only next-state action requires f' = f. The specification appears to exercise function-set construction over empty and singleton sets rather than model a larger algorithm, and it contains no explicit temporal property beyond the action definitions.
